questions.prompt: Explain why 22/7 cannot be exactly equal to π.
questions.modelAnswer: 22/7 is a fraction of two integers, so it is rational and its decimal (3.142857142857…) repeats. π is irrational: its decimal never ends and never repeats. So they cannot be equal; 22/7 is only an approximation (they differ from the third decimal place).
